listing.name: Doom 3 (classic) (DUDE — Doom 3 Unified Development Engine)
listing.summary: Prepare Doom 3 (classic) through its upstream player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Use the matching original game
steps.instruction: Use original classic Doom 3 base PK4 data. BFG Edition is a different product. Keep the complete matching original-data installation unchanged and use a private working copy or the explicit upstream data-root option.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the player
steps.instruction: Keep the complete dude-0.9.6-win64.zip and its DLL/resources together. Register dude.exe in its runtime folder. Point to the folder containing base with three separate argument lines: +set, fs_basepath, then the absolute data-root path. Optional baked-AO downloads are separate from the player. Check the upstream renderer and hardware requirements for your chosen mode; dhewm3 test results do not apply to this fork.

steps.title: Preserve the actual player data
steps.instruction: Windows normally stores saves and settings under the actual Documents/My Games/dude profile, with base/d3xp scopes. Explicit fs_savepath or mod paths can redirect writes. Preserve the actual profile, originals and creating runtime. Linux uses its own upstream location; no cross-engine or mod save compatibility is inferred. Before first Play, preserve both the existing Documents/My Games/dhewm3 profile and its creating runtime as well as any dude profile. If the dude profile is missing, this upstream Windows build silently copies the existing dhewm3 tree into it. A private original/runtime copy does not isolate that profile behavior. The game copies that profile without moving the original. Portcove does not manage the copied profile, and save compatibility has not been confirmed. Decide whether to allow this before choosing Play.

steps.title: Add the game and manage your files
steps.instruction: Finish setup with the project’s tools before adding the game. Select the game executable and its working folder, and put each launch argument on a separate line. Choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage this game’s files, originals, saves and settings. Removing its registration leaves those external files in place. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, data migration or file deletion for this external copy. Close the game and keep a working copy and every data and profile folder before changing versions. Other platforms need their own setup instructions.

warnings: First Play can copy an existing dhewm3 profile into a missing dude profile. Preserve both and decide before continuing.
